title: Rotterdam wind surge leads TTF
hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Rotterdam daily max wind 20d z-score > 1 (North Sea wind surge, more wind power, less gas burn) leads TTF log returns by 2 days (+wind, -price); trade TTF=F 2d [weather.rotterdam.wind_max -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0025)

trade_idea.entry_rule: weather.rotterdam.wind_max rolling_zscore_20d > 1 at close -> long TTF=F next session
trade_idea.exit_rule: close after 1 trading days (no overlapping entries)
trade_idea.caveats: Backtest on daily closes, no costs/slippage; few independent regimes; signal and target may share the war as common cause.

followup_hypothesis: R2 | [gas-lng] Wind direction flip: Rotterdam mean wind (ISD) 20d z-score > 1 leads TTF log returns by 1 day (-price, short TTF), since the max-wind long rule lost money (Sharpe -0.49) suggesting the sign was reversed; trade short TTF=F 1d [weather.rotterdam.isd_wind_mean -> finance.TTF=F.log_return] (parent: R2-0123)
